name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: Global manufacturing PMI 52.6 in October; composite reading still above 51 in latest data
state: The J.P.Morgan Global Manufacturing PMI eased to 52.6 in October from 53.0, still well above 50 (S&P Global). The global composite was at its joint-highest since 2021 in September; the October composite had not been found as of 5 Nov. No reading near the 51 Watch line has been reported.
for_you: Global factory activity is still expanding; no broad downturn is signalled for trade-exposed jobs.
why: Purchasing-manager surveys are the fastest read on whether the world economy is expanding or contracting.
drivers: Orders, inventories, trade policy, energy costs, credit conditions.
